notes.notes:

notes.title: Release v1
notes.notes:
Full Game Release:

    ** IT IS HIGHLY RECOMMENDED FOR ALL PRE-RELEASE OWNERS TO "RESET ALL PROGRESS" FROM THE OPTIONS MENU **

    - created INTRO level to learn the basics of how to play the game
    - click-drag resize window, the background now rescales
    - Prevent "lift" arrows from being destroyed with blocks
        - confirmed lightbox not being destroyed with blocks
    - Removed extra lamp in theend
    - replaced "tutorial" with a redesigned "intro" level (better guidance!)
    - cleaned up various room templates for Chaos Mode

--------------------------------

Thank you for the great support throughout the development process of this game!  If there are any issues, be sure to post in the forums.

Thanks!
-SyKoHPaTh

notes.title: Beta Patch 1.7
notes.notes:
This is the last beta patch before release version

    -Editor
        - if entity placed in block, delete the entity (entity size)
        - fixed help text reference alignment
        - in play mode, add reset
        --CTRL-P: When playing a level, delete saved data of file from appdata/modified
    -- when player gets hit (by anything) shower with "blood" debris
    -- video settings save/cancel not visible at 800x600
    -- Completing a Workshop mod shows a "GOAL" completion screen
    -- Fixed: Fullscreen -> video config -> while still fullscreen, change resolution -> apply -> save -> save (at this point it flips back?) 
    -- Hub: Fix door for thecastle, add door for thetraps
    -- TheFarm: redo first section
    -- TheTraps: remove every other cannon from punishment fall
    -- Misc levels: minor fixes
    -- Fix control queue "sticky key" issue when press shift down -> key down (shifted value) -> shift up -> key up (unshifted value)
    -- Default Video Screen Mode to "window"
    -- select highcontrast should reload sprites
    -- Map: color code the boss & coin doors
    -- Make Resizable window work through entire game
    -- Fix traps getting "caught" on corners

notes.title: Beta Patch 1.6
notes.notes:
Patch Notes (VERSION: BETA1.6)
    - (v1.5s) Fixed issue where a Steam username with special characters was messing up the configuration file.  Now, all non-Steam versions of the game will use "Player", while Steam version will grab the user's name from Steam instead of grabbing once and saving to a file.
    - Fixed double mouse cursor in video
    - "theroom" now links to "thetraps"
    - world 6: added marker sprite for optimization (top)
    - Storyboards for all characters
    - Editor: 
        - Added "Selection Tool"
        - Added Cut/Copy/Paste (works for tiles only right now)
        - Added Undo/Redo
        - fixed painting - it actually paints the whole area now!
        - Custom Selection Area Sprites
        - Show dummy area from clipboard
